questions.question: Explain why Easter is the most important Christian festival.

points.text: Easter is the most important festival because it celebrates the resurrection — the event on which the entire Christian faith depends. Without the resurrection, Jesus would be just a dead teacher, and there would be no salvation. questions.question: Explain two ways Christians celebrate Christmas.

points.text: 1) Many Christians attend a Midnight Mass or Christmas Day service, which includes nativity readings from Luke's Gospel, carols, and a celebration of Jesus' birth. 2) Christians set up nativity scenes in churches and homes, depicting the birth of Jesus in a manger with Mary, Joseph and the shepherds, to remind themselves and their families of the true meaning of Christmas amid commercialisation.
